requirement: ask what is on my desktop right now
message: What is on my desktop right now? Inspect the desktop and tell me what you see.

requirement: open a desktop folder, open a PDF, and tell me what it is about
message: Open the desktop folder {{desktop_folder}} and open the PDF file inside it, then tell me what the PDF is about.

requirement: send me the PDF file it found or opened
message: Send me the PDF file at {{pdf_path}}.

requirement: organize documents in a folder based on criteria and report changes
message: Organize my documents in {{documents_folder}} by file type and tell me exactly what changed.

requirement: send me a screenshot of the desktop
message: Take a screenshot of my desktop and send it to me now.

requirement: open browser, go to a website, and send a screenshot
message: Open the browser, go to {{fixture_base_url}}/index.html, and send me a screenshot of what it sees.

requirement: search, open the first web page, and summarize it
message: Open the browser, search for Python official documentation, go into the first web page, and tell me what that page is about.

requirement: go to a web page and check whether a new show or episode came out
message: Go to {{episode_url}} and check whether a new episode came out.

requirement: go to a web page and start filling out a form
message: Go to {{form_url}} and start filling out the form with name=Oney, email=oney@example.com, message=Hello from E2E. Do not submit.

requirement: say use Codex and have it use Codex
message: Use Codex to write a tiny hello world Python script in the task workspace.

requirement: say use GitHub Copilot and have it use GitHub Copilot
message: Use GitHub Copilot to write a tiny hello world Python script in the task workspace.

requirement: do not use Codex or GitHub Copilot unless specifically named
message: Create a small modern web app about hamsters and mice and launch it.

requirement: use Codex to start creating an app for mobile deployment of an LLM
message: Use Codex and start creating an app for mobile deployment of an LLM. Create a plan first and begin the first implementation step.

requirement: use Codex for a weird app idea like hamsters and mice
message: Use Codex to create a weird small app idea about hamsters and mice. Start implementing it in the task workspace.

requirement: tell coding process status and give screenshot of VS Code and file directory
message: Tell me where the coding process is and send a screenshot of VS Code and the file directory.

requirement: use Codex and create a PowerPoint presentation and send it
message: Use Codex and create me a PowerPoint presentation about local LLM deployment with 3 slides and send it to me.

requirement: send a follow-up asking for presentation changes and get revised output
message: Update that PowerPoint presentation to make it more visual, add one slide about risks, and send the revised output.

requirement: large website or app requirement first prepares a plan
message: Use Codex for a large website project: build a dashboard for local LLM deployment with auth, job history, logs, and deployment status. Prepare a plan first before implementation.

requirement: use Codex and search, or use GitHub Copilot and web search
message: Use Codex and web search to research local LLM deployment options, then write a short implementation note in the workspace.

requirement: web search through many pages, even 50 pages
message: Do a web search for local LLM deployment on Windows, go through 50 pages if available, and give me the results.

requirement: ask it to create an adapter to access something
message: Create an adapter to access a fake calendar service API. Put the adapter proposal in the adapter cache and do not load it automatically.

requirement: set up a scheduled job like every day
message: Set up a scheduled job every day to check {{episode_url}} and tell me if a new episode came out.

requirement: scheduled job searches internet or checks a website daily
message: Set up a scheduled job every 1 minutes to check {{episode_url}} and tell me if a new episode came out.

requirement: use Codex or Copilot in workspace to prepare scheduled job code
message: Use Codex in the workspace to prepare code for a scheduled job, then schedule it every day to search the web for local LLM news.

requirement: ask current availability of Codex and whether almost at limit
message: Use Codex and tell me the current Codex availability and whether I am almost at the limit.

requirement: tell me when Codex reaches a limit while developing
message: Use Codex for a development task and tell me clearly if Codex reaches a usage limit while working.

requirement: stop on Codex limit, check renewal, continue after it renews
message: Use Codex for a task that should pause if a usage limit is reached, remember the plan, and continue after renewal.

requirement: implement large plan one piece at a time using Codex
message: Use Codex to build a large task management web app. Create a plan first, then implement only the first safe step.

requirement: wait for Codex to finish one step, read result, then send next piece
message: Use Codex to do two small implementation steps. Wait for the first result, read it, then send the next step.

requirement: continue slowly until complete unless tool limit is reached
message: Use Codex to work continuously but slowly on a small app until it is complete unless a tool limit is reached.

requirement: preserve plan and continue from where it stopped
message: Use Codex to resume the previous large plan from where it stopped, not from the beginning.

requirement: send outputs along the way such as screenshots, files, summaries, code, PowerPoints
message: Send me the latest output from the current task, including any screenshot, file, summary, code, or PowerPoint artifact you have.

requirement: natural task descriptions across desktop, browser, files, coding, schedules, and delivery
message: Open {{episode_url}}, summarize what it says, create a short note in {{documents_folder}}, and send me the result.
